a: TCP uses seq/ack numbers, retransmits, and checksums for reliability.
Receiver window limits sender to what the receiver can buffer.
Algorithms like Reno/CUBIC probe bandwidth and react to loss.
Slow start grows the congestion window exponentially at first.
Triple duplicate ACKs trigger fast retransmit without waiting RTO.
Keepalives detect dead peers on idle connections.
TCP_NODELAY disables Nagle for latency-sensitive small writes.
Lost packets block later data in the same TCP stream.
TIME_WAIT holds closed sockets to handle delayed packets.
SYN floods exhaust half-open connection state; SYN cookies help.
